parent_objective: audit the completed 864-cell public controller-family rollout before interpretation or next route
blocked_by: need result audit before interpreting controller-family comparison aggregates or selecting the next paper-route branch
supersedes: direct controller-family ranking from M1693 raw aggregates
direct recurrent-advantage claim from M1693 raw aggregates

public_gates: M1694 must audit M1693 required artifacts, counts, finite metrics, failure rows, and guardrails
M1694 may inspect diagnostic profile/spec/stratum/comparison aggregates but must not treat them as private-holdout or paper-level evidence
M1694 must classify whether the rollout is a clean execution pass, an execution artifact failure, or a task-quality/comparison-semantics issue
M1694 must route to the next explicit design, synthesis, repair, or scenario-quality audit before any ranking claim
forbidden_shortcuts: do not tune profiles from M1693 diagnostics

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits the first full public controller-family measured rollout before interpretation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit and next-route decision only; no training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if M1693 required artifacts are incomplete
stop if M1693 finite-metric or guardrail pass cannot be verified
stop if comparison aggregates are being interpreted without task-quality caveats
stop if next route is not explicit
fallback_plan: route to execution-artifact repair if artifacts are incomplete
route to task-quality audit if rollout is complete but diagnostics are not interpretable
route to branch synthesis or next measured protocol design if rollout is clean and interpretable enough for the next stage
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1693 completes the first full 864-cell public rollout

admission_evidence: M1693 completed the materialized 864-cell public rollout with summary and aggregate artifacts
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1694 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up design synthesis repair or task-quality manifest
next_stage_criteria: M1693 artifact integrity and guardrails are audited

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1694 audits public rollout diagnostics but does not by itself prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audit L1, L2-current-tiled, L3-online, and L3-reset comparison rows as diagnostic only
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If reset/current-tiled controls match or beat history profiles, record this as task-quality or history-necessity evidence gap instead of weakening the claim standard.
allowed_claims: no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no promotion, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1693 can be audited as a clean public execution pass and routed to the next paper-route step without overclaiming raw controller-family diagnostics.
success_criteria: M1693 counts finite metrics failure rows and guardrails are audited
diagnostic aggregate interpretation caveats are recorded
training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit interprets M1693 raw diagnostics as controller-family ranking or paper-level evidence
audit routes to training or profile tuning without a design milestone
training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur

commands.name: audit
commands.command: audit M1693 full rollout artifacts and write next-route decision

decision_rule: M1694 passes if it audits M1693 as a clean execution result or records explicit artifact/task-quality caveats and routes to the next milestone without overclaiming.
